item.title: Ethena, FalconX Launch $1B Facility to Back Institutional Loans
item.summary: Ethena and FalconX have established a $1 billion secured warehouse facility designed to deploy assets backing Ethena’s USDe synthetic dollar into overcollateralized loans for institutional borrowers. The arrangement, announced on Aug. 19, represents an effort to expand the sources of returns supporting USDe beyond the crypto market strategies that have traditionally contributed to its yield.
